title: Austin Explores New Parks
summary:
*   City leaders held a special, private Executive Session to discuss the acquisition of land.
*   The sole focus of this confidential meeting was considering various sites for potential new public parks.
*   No immediate public decisions were made; any actions regarding land purchases were deferred to a future open meeting.
